JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: A user-authored audio or written journal entry with NLP emotion and sentiment analysis.

dateKey.description: Calendar day key in YYYY-MM-DD format for daily emotion accumulation.

title.description: Short, clear title for the memory entry.

content.description: Written journal text or transcribed audio journal content.

entryType.description: Indicates whether the entry originated from an audio recording or typed text.

audioFileName.description: Optional local private audio filename for on-device playback.

audioDurationSec.description: Duration of the audio recording in seconds (0 for text-only entries).

primaryEmotion.description: Primary emotion category assigned by NLP sentiment analysis or user selection.

sentimentPolarity.description: Overall sentiment classification of the entry.

sentimentScore.description: Positivity and emotional well-being score from 0 to 100.

positiveHighlight.description: Optional warm highlight or supportive reflection extracted by AI.

promptUsed.description: Optional AI journaling starter prompt that inspired this entry.

keyTopics.description: Up to 5 short topic labels identified from the entry.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation and updates.

WeeklySummary.title: WeeklySummary
WeeklySummary.description: AI-generated summary of a user's top positive memories from the past 7 days.

weekLabel.description: Readable date range label for the summarized week.

headline.description: Warm, uplifting headline for the weekly reflection.

summaryText.description: Simple, comforting summary paragraph of the week's positive memories.

highlights.description: Up to 5 short positive memory highlights from the week.

positiveEntryCount.description: Number of positive entries included in the summary.

totalEntryCount.description: Total journal entries reviewed for the week.

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: User reminder schedule and high-contrast accessibility display settings.

morningReminderEnabled.description: Whether the morning journaling reminder is active.

eveningReminderEnabled.description: Whether the evening journaling reminder is active.

reminderMessage.description: Gentle customizable reminder text shown in notifications.

highContrastDark.description: Whether ultra-high-contrast dark display mode is enabled.

/users/{userId}/journal_entries/{entryId.description: User-scoped audio and text journal entries with emotion and sentiment analysis.

/users/{userId}/weekly_summaries/{weekId.description: User-scoped AI summaries of weekly top positive memories.

/users/{userId}/preferences/{prefId}.description: User-scoped reminder schedules and high-contrast display preferences.
